pin_regs.reason: ot_s81_hc_ccf already registers every data input and every output directly at its port in RTL (fd_i->fd_p, n_y->y1, n_yacc->ya, fv_i->fv_p + the 24 kept pop copies; ch_fd/ch_fv/yfl/ch_rst are flop outputs, ch_rst cloned to its own launch flop by pin_reg_split). The recipe-3 wrapper would add a second, redundant stage on all 6,600 pins (+6.4k sinks -> >15k on one root) and +2 cycles on the HC centre chain whose lockstep padding (FP/RP) is fixed in cpad; the native fix is placement (current io_flop_at_pins anchors every capture flop of a multi-load input at its pin) + the clock spine. 0 cycles.

reroute_reason.fix: balanced symmetric clock spine (boundary spread 171 -> ~30 ps) + every capture flop of fv_i[2] anchored at its pin + dedicated ch_rst launch flop (pin_reg_split) + HB2 pin pads; same RTL, pins and outline

fill_reason.pin_bound: N face carries 3,697 input pins (fd_i 1,128 + n_y 2,560 + fv_i 7 + n_yacc + yfl) and S face 2,924 outputs, channel-only (no pin over the 171 um macro column): 3,697 / 239 um = 15.5 pins/um on M3+M5 at the die-assigned v18 rectangles; the 410.4 um width is set by the pins, not the cells (v2 302.4 um: PPL-0111, 3,135 slots < 3,697). Outline unchanged from the closed v5 view and the die slot.
